scope: Standing Rococo exterior in São João del-Rei, including the round towers and their balustraded crowns, carved front and cross, curved nave, rear chancel and attached sacristy, and stone forecourt steps.

stories.title: Church of Saint Francis of Assisi (Sao Joao del-Rei)

review.notes: Qualla’s exact candidate is the 18th-century design drawing attributed to Aleijadinho, with octagonal towers that differ from the standing building. The record describes a modern faithful scan and requests a separate U.S. public-domain tag. The scan and other artist renderings were excluded. Modern architectural photos were excluded where the license required attribution or the tourism source marked the photographer credit mandatory. Historical photo records did not establish a publication basis for the original. No imagery was adopted.
